blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — More than 5,800 agrarian reform beneficiaries (ARBs) across the Caraga region gained full individual ownership of the lands they till on Thursday, Nov. 12, as the Department of Agrarian Reform (DAR) distributed titles covering 10,777.9566 hectares (ha) in a massive rollout. Farmers from Agusan del Sur comprised the bulk of the recipients, with 3,120 ARBs claiming individual titles for 6,101.1337 ha across 3,394 land parcels during the distribution drive at the J.P. Satorre Gymnasium in Buenavista town in Agusan del Norte. The titles were issued under DAR’s Support to Parcelization of Lands for Individual Titling […]...
